title: Hack Back Your Desktop
coreMove: Arrange the desktop so the next intended action is visible and competing paths require deliberate effort.
sourcePressure: The chapter extends trigger redesign to the larger digital workspace, focusing on defaults, visibility, and switching paths.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would confuse a clean desktop with a governed desktop.

hook: Hack Back Your Desktop as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: civil engineer reviewing bridge inspection photos
exampleSpecs.audience: engineer whose desktop opens into old bid folders
exampleSpecs.stakes: defect review loses focus when file paths invite switching
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she docks only the inspection viewer and load table, then hides the bid archive
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A bridge bearing photo fills one monitor beside a load table.

exampleSpecs.domain: podcast editor cutting a witness interview
exampleSpecs.audience: editor pulled by waveform, chat, and analytics windows
exampleSpecs.stakes: the narrative cut suffers if analytics become a lure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he saves a session layout with transcript and waveform only before touching the edit
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A waveform timeline stretches beside a printed transcript scan.

exampleSpecs.domain: estate jewelry appraiser writing certificate notes
exampleSpecs.stakes: certificate accuracy needs the item in front, not endless comparison
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, five auction tabs stay open; after, she pins the loupe photo and one grading sheet
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A loupe photo is magnified beside a grading sheet.

exampleSpecs.audience: attorney whose desktop mixes messaging and footage
exampleSpecs.stakes: timeline notes can miss a key second
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he creates a footage-only workspace and moves messaging to the next timed review
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A timestamped body-camera frame sits above a case timeline.

exampleSpecs.domain: genealogy researcher verifying a ship manifest
exampleSpecs.audience: researcher who keeps wandering into family-history forums
exampleSpecs.stakes: one record gets confused with another if tabs sprawl
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she leaves only the manifest scan and citation template, then writes the source line first
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A ship manifest scan sits beside a citation template.

exampleSpecs.audience: accountant whose desktop carries every prior spreadsheet
exampleSpecs.stakes: bond figures need one clean calculation path
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he opens a single bond workbook and moves old sheets into a closed reference folder
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A bond amortization table fills the screen beside a sealed reference folder.
